name: HERD
summary: Planned high-energy cosmic-radiation facility on the Chinese space station, with goals including indirect dark-matter searches, cosmic-ray spectra up to the knee and all-sky gamma-ray monitoring.
detection_principle: A deep three-dimensional calorimeter accepts particles from multiple directions; charge and tracking detectors improve geometrical acceptance and spectral precision.

sites.name: External payload platform of the Chinese space station, planned
sites.location: External payload platform of the Chinese space station, planned

status.label: Announced plan
status.evidence: The project page gives a plan for operation from about 2027; no evidence of launch.

phases.name: Formal space-station mission
phases.description: Cannot yet be counted as an orbiting dark-matter detector

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
